headline: Executive order sets up a National Strategic Computing Initiative, a federal effort focused on advanced computing.
what_it_does: This order creates a national initiative on computing, signed by President Obama in 2015. Based on the title alone, it sets up a federal strategy to guide government work on advanced computing. No summary was provided, so details such as which agencies lead it, its goals, and any funding are not covered here.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies that do computing research or rely on advanced computers
who_it_affects.how: These agencies would be expected to take part in or follow the new national computing strategy.

when_it_takes_effect: Likely on signing, July 29, 2015 (executive orders usually take effect when signed)
